description: Crawfish IMG_4110 now gets past the re-carve but fails in the grid map with 'patch 10946 boundary is pinched, not a disk'. CRAW-144 traced it to a zero-patch collapse (LCBK19 §6.2) leaving an arc with the same patch on both sides. Context: since CRAW-141, CRAW-142, MESH-97, CRAW-146 and CRAW-144 landed, crawfish IMG_4111, 4112 and 4118 finish quad_layout; the rest fail in separate places (IMG_4113 is the quantization stall, CRAW-147). The CRAW-144 agent diagnosed this one; its diagnostics folder went with its worktree at land, so re-measure first.
definition-of-done:
1. The collapse that pinches patch 10946 is shown: which zero patch, which arc ends up with the patch on both sides, and why LCBK19 §6.2's operator allows it (numbers and an engine screenshot under tmp/).
2. A fix following the paper the stage implements (read it first, start from the papers: list ixd wt new prints), not a workaround stage, and the scan(s) get past this stage: report the furthest quad_layout stage before and after, with an engine screenshot if the layout finishes.
3. A unit test with a hand-made fixture, failing on master and passing after.
4. The 11 quad-layout suite models and the T-Rex skull are unchanged (same quad, patch and cone counts) and ixd wt perf shows no regression.
testing-plan:

2. A unit test with a hand-made fixture reproducing the failure without loading a scan, failing on master and passing after.
3. After the fix: the named scans, the 11 quad-layout suite models, the T-Rex skull, ixd wt perf.
